TwoIsland_House_Text_TeachMonMoveForMush:
I'm the POKéMON MOVE MANIAC.
I know every single move that POKéMON learn growing up.
I'm also a mushroom maniac.
Bring me two TINYMUSHROOMS, or one BIG MUSHROOM.
If you do that for me, I'll teach a move to one POKéMON.
TwoIsland_House_Text_WantMeToTeachMove:
Sniff, sniff… Hm! You smell of MUSHROOMS!
Do you want me to teach a move to a POKéMON of yours?
TwoIsland_House_Text_NoMoveICanTeachThat:
Sorry…
It doesn't appear as if I have a move I can teach that POKéMON.
TwoIsland_House_Text_IllNeedMushroomOrTw: Then, I'll need a MUSHROOM or two. What are you going to give me?
TwoIsland_House_Text_HandedOverTwoTinyMu: {PLAYER} handed over two TINYMUSHROOMS in exchange.
TwoIsland_House_Text_HandedOverOneBigMus: {PLAYER} handed over one BIG MUSHROOM in exchange.
TwoIsland_House_Text_NeedMushroomOrTwoTo: If your POKéMON need to learn a move, I need a MUSHROOM or two.
TwoIsland_House_Text_CantTeachAnEgg: Hunh? There isn't a single move that I can teach an EGG.
